threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the tube' instead of just 'the Overground' when you're in Hackney. It's a giveaway.
Caught a bloke on the night bus serenading the driver with some old soul tracks, made the 12am ride feel like a proper gig. Only in Peckham.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a kid selling homemade lemonade outside the Späti while their grandma knitted on a foldable chair. Pure Neukölln charm.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a café that sells coffee brewed by nine different methods, from siphon to cold brew, while surrounded by murals of famous punk bands.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a true local by their instinct to avoid Civic Center during a BART outage; they find the hidden bus routes no one else knows.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy serenading the 38 bus with a ukulele and a crowd of commuters joined in. Just another Tuesday in the TL, I guess.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think Gràcia is just for the nightlife, but the morning aroma of fresh pa amb tomàquet from local cafés is pure magic.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by their reluctance to sit on the steps of a plaza; seasoned locals wouldn’t think twice about it, but newcomers avoid the ground like it's dirty.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think a 'pint' is just a drink, not a crisis when the tube's down and you can’t find a bus for miles.
Caught the 196 last night; a guy brought his pet ferret on board. No one batted an eye. Just another Brixton night, I guess.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I caught the scent of fresh döner at 3 AM, weaving through the late-night laughter outside Aroma Café. That's when it felt like home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a place that serves currywurst topped with mango chutney and spiced with curry powder, all at a street stall by the canal.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by their ease navigating BART’s delays, while newcomers assume it’s always on time. They’re still waiting for that mythical express train.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a glimpse of a saxophonist jamming on the N line this morning. Riders were swaying, forgetting their delays. Magic happens in the madness.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think Gràcia is just for bars and terraces, but they miss the hidden local markets where we actually shop daily.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They often stand at the wrong tram stop, staring at their phones, clearly unsure of which direction to head next.
